scenes.title_cn: 剪刀手 vs 端起饮品
scenes.title_en: Peace Sign vs. Raising the Drink
scenes.context: 拍了：剪刀手，手空着、表情僵。出片：端起饮品，自然松弛。核心是和食物互动，替代尴尬剪刀手。语域：拍照教学，错对对比。
sentences: 拍了：剪刀手，手空着、表情僵。
Took it: peace sign, empty hands, stiff face.
empty hands（手空着）
出片：端起饮品，自然松弛。
The shot: raise the drink, naturally relaxed.
naturally relaxed（自然松弛）
和食物互动，比剪刀手出片多了。
Interacting with food beats a peace sign every time.
interacting with food（和食物互动）
paraphrase: 自然松弛 → naturally relaxed / effortless and at ease
scenes.speak: Took it: peace sign, empty hands, stiff face. The shot: raise the drink, naturally relaxed. Interacting with food beats a peace sign every time.

scenes.context: 出片：夹菜停嘴边，有过程感。夹起菜停在嘴边，画面有故事性。语域：拍照教学，动作示范。
sentences: 出片：夹菜停嘴边，有过程感。
The shot: pause with chopsticks at the lips — a sense of process.
a sense of process（过程感）
夹菜停在嘴边，画面有故事。
Holding the bite at your lips gives the frame a story.
gives the frame a story（画面有故事）
动作有过程，比静态摆拍生动。
Moves in progress beat a static pose.
moves in progress（有过程的动作）
paraphrase: 停嘴边 → pause at the lips / stop at the mouth
pause at lips · stop at mouth
过程感 → a sense of process / an in-between moment
scenes.speak: The shot: pause with chopsticks at the lips — a sense of process. Holding the bite at your lips gives the frame a story. Moves in progress beat a static pose.

scenes.title_cn: 咬一口 + 双手捧食物
scenes.title_en: Take a Bite and Hold the Food in Both Hands
scenes.context: 出片：咬一口，嘴角带笑；双手捧食物贴近下巴。咬一口+捧食物贴近脸，画面温馨。语域：拍照教学，动作示范。
sentences: 出片：咬一口，嘴角带笑。
The shot: take a bite with a smile at the corner of the mouth.
a smile at the corner（嘴角带笑）
双手捧食物，贴近下巴。
Hold the food in both hands, close to your chin.
close to your chin（贴近下巴）
捧近一点，脸更小更上镜。
Bring it closer and your face looks smaller on camera.
smaller on camera（上镜显小）
paraphrase: 咬一口 → take a bite / bite into it
贴近下巴 → close to the chin / near the jaw
scenes.speak: The shot: take a bite with a smile at the corner of the mouth. Hold the food in both hands, close to your chin. Bring it closer and your face looks smaller on camera.

scenes.title_en: Lean in Low and Wrap Up
scenes.context: 出片：低头凑近，松弛期待感。低头凑近食物，带着期待感，画面松弛自然。和食物互动的四个姿势，都比剪刀手出片。语域：拍照教学，收尾。
sentences: 出片：低头凑近，松弛期待感。
The shot: head down, leaning close — a relaxed anticipation.
relaxed anticipation（松弛期待感）
低头凑近食物，带着期待。
Dip your head toward the food with anticipation.
dip your head（低头）
和食物互动的姿势，都比剪刀手出片。
Food-interaction poses all beat the peace sign.
beat the peace sign（比剪刀手出片）
paraphrase: 比剪刀手出片 → beat the peace sign / better than a V-sign
beat peace sign · better than V
scenes.speak: The shot: head down, leaning close — a relaxed anticipation. Dip your head toward the food with anticipation. Food-interaction poses all beat the peace sign.

practice: Interacting with food beats a peace sign every time.
Pause with chopsticks at the lips — a sense of process.
Take a bite with a smile and hold the food close to your chin.
Dip your head toward the food with a relaxed anticipation.
pitfalls: Don't make a peace sign — interact with food.
Empty hands look stiff — hold something.
Stop the chopsticks in the mouth.
Pause with chopsticks at the lips.
「停嘴边」用 pause at the lips，不是 in the mouth。
Dip your head toward the food with anticipation.
「低头凑近」用 dip your head toward。
shifts: 用 raise the drink（端起饮品）、pause at the lips（停嘴边）、dip your head（低头凑近）
用 relaxed anticipation（松弛期待感）、at ease（松弛）、sense of process（过程感）
用 beat the peace sign（比剪刀手出片）、moves in progress（有过程的动作）
